# Tano Core 0.8.0

- Separate Home navigation and personal preferences from workspace views and settings.
- Apply workspace document capabilities consistently to rendered Markdown, source highlighting, selection wrapping and automatic spacing; add syntax and rendering examples.
- Preserve the caret and selection when revealing inline Markdown source and switching editing modes.
- Refine editor tools, shortcut descriptions, document status, workspace deletion controls and accessible tooltips.
- Fade overflowing file-tree edges while preserving file operations and scroll behavior.
- Add workspace extension commands and context-sensitive settings visibility.

Existing Markdown remains the source of truth. This release requires no workspace data migration.
